correctness.rationale: PASS: The lattice slice at height j in t Q_{r,c} has binom(t+cj+r,r) points for r>=4, c>=0, t>=0, so the exact sum j=0..t is a degree-(r+1) Ehrhart polynomial. Its top twist coefficients are c^r S_r(t)/r! and c^(r-1)(t+(r+1)/2)S_(r-1)(t)/(r-1)!. Bernoulli B_{2h}!=0 gives first-tier e_{r+1-2h} coefficient binom(r+1,2h)B_{2h}/(r!(r+1)), and the odd Bernoulli cancellation yields second-tier e_{r-2h} coefficient (r+1)binom(r,2h)B_{2h}/[2r(r-1)!]. Top two degrees and constant are positive; alternating even Bernoulli signs make precisely r+1-4j and r-4j (j>=1) negative when those degrees >=1. Each coefficient is polynomial in c with nonzero leading term, so simultaneous eventual c0(r) exists. Independent exact slice/polynomial checks in bounded r corroborated rather than replaced this uniform proof.
